title: Jesus Paid it All
lyrics_original: I hear the Savior say,
Thy strength indeed is small;
Child of weakness, watch and pray,
Find in Me thine all in all.
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.
Lord, now indeed I find
Thy power and Thine alone,
Can change the leper's spots
and melt the heart of stone.
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow.
And when before the throne
I stand in Him complete,
Jesus died my soul to save,
my lips shall still repeat
Jesus paid it all,
All to Him I owe;
Sin had left a crimson stain,
He washed it white as snow

bible_verses.telugu: యెహోవా ఈ మాట సెలవిచ్చుచున్నాడు రండి మన వివాదము తీర్చుకొందము మీ పాపములు రక్తమువలె ఎఱ్ఱనివైనను అవి హిమము  వలె తెల్లబడును కెంపువలె ఎఱ్ఱనివైనను అవి గొఱ్ఱబొచ్చువలె తెల్లని వగును.
bible_verses.english: "Come now, let us settle the matter," says the Lord. "Though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they are red as crimson, they shall be like wool."

bible_verses.telugu: మరియు అపరాధముల వలనను, శరీరమందు సున్నతిపొందక యుండుటవలనను, మీరు మృతులై యుండగా, దేవుడు వ్రాతరూపకమైన ఆజ్ఞలవలన మనమీద ఋణముగాను మనకు విరోధముగాను నుండిన పత్రమును మేకులతో సిలువకు కొట్టి, దానిమీది చేవ్రాతను తుడిచివేసి,మనకు అడ్డములేకుండ దానిని ఎత్తి వేసి మన అపరాధములనన్నిటిని క్షమించి,
bible_verses.english: When you were dead in your sins and in the uncircumcision of your flesh, God made you alive with Christ. He forgave us all our sins, having canceled the charge of our legal indebtedness, which stood against us and condemned us; he has taken it away, nailing it to the cross.

bible_verses.telugu: అందుకునా కృప నీకు చాలును, బలహీనతయందు నాశక్తి పరిపూర్ణమగుచున్నదని ఆయన నాతో చెప్పెను. కాగా క్రీస్తు శక్తి నామీద నిలిచియుండు నిమిత్తము, విశేషముగా నా బలహీనతలయందె
bible_verses.english: But he said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." Therefore I will boast all the more gladly about my weaknesses, so that Christ’s power may rest on me.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for paying the price I could never pay. Forgive me for the times I try to earn Your favor or carry the weight of my own weakness. I surrender my struggles to You today, trusting that Your grace is sufficient and Your blood cleanses me completely. Help me to rest in Your finished work and live each day in joyful gratitude for Your boundless love. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for paying the price I could never pay. Forgive me for the times I try to earn Your favor or carry the weight of my own weakness. devotional.reflection_english: In our moments of weakness, we are often tempted to rely on our own efforts to fix our shortcomings and make ourselves right before God. Yet this beloved hymn gently reminds us that our strength was never meant to be enough. Jesus saw our deepest need and freely paid the entire debt of our sin on the cross, turning our crimson stains into purest white. As you sing, let go of the burden of self-reliance and rest fully in His complete, finished work of grace.
